name: LingBot-World 2.0
description: An interactive world model that supports continuous, hour-long real-time generation. It features a native dual-agent mechanism that allows for dynamically evolving environments responding to real-time user inputs without scene collapse.
keyFeatures: Continuous hour-long generation at 720p/60fps with zero quality drift
Dual-agent mechanism (Pilot Agent and Director Agent) for dynamic scene events
Supports multiplayer persistence within a single generated world
